name: Toilet Story
source:
Darkness. Cold. You wake up alone in a school that isn’t quite right. Something is watching you. Your only goal is to reach the toilet before everything falls apart.

[From [url=https://ewlampia.itch.io/toilet-story]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
黑暗。寒冷的。你在一个不太合适的学校里独自醒来。有东西在看着你。你唯一的目标是在一切崩溃之前到达厕所。

[来自[url=https://ewlampia.itch.io/toilet-story]Itch.io[/url]]
